entry_points.text: Native validates arch, duplicates descriptors, invokes loader and frees. Compat rejects default arch and translates fieldwise. File entry handles install or remove with screening, staging, integrity and publish.
Preparation notifies, marks restarting, blocks helpers, shuts devices; migration pins to online reboot CPU. Init creates kexec object with groups and legacy aliases; early hook registers controls.
Boot registers erasing controls. Boot publishes headers; exit unpublishes.

exports.text: Reboot handoff declines when busy or unstaged, else prepares and passes to machine layer. Staging permission combines capability, disable switch and decremented per-kind allowance.
Maps staged segment for inspection, using preallocated area directly or gathering source pages; companion release frees only virtually mapped ranges.

Builds executable description refusing non-executable or interpreter inputs. Probes via temp state plus compatibility, stages extents with source, lengths, alignment and dest reporting lowest, frees table.
Default handler selection tries loaders in order, default cleanup delegates when present, verification tries secondary keys then platform fallback, plus toggle enabling mandatory enforcement.
Fixed-size bidirectional transfer with purgatory symbol after existence, size and section checks; placement selection, purgatory load and symbol address resolution; handover hook always continues.
Forward, reverse and descriptor-filtered walkers over memory resources accept interval, context and callback, visit matches in order and propagate termination to stop scanning.
Generic and task-stack erasing gates with internal bypass decision plus depth hook narrowing tracked lowest stack for later erasure.

hazards.text: Denial and invalid input on load check, release on header decode fail, abort on bad preparation, busy on conflicting execution.
Mapping returns null on fail with diagnostic and warning. Buffer sizing and contig reservation fail on alloc or overlap with cleanup.
Placement and resource paths report invalid arg, busy and unavailable with memory and descriptor flags.

invariants.text: Origin is in-kernel buffer in file mode else caller memory. Normal pagewise clears, copies available part and yields; crash writes direct with zero tail and flush; CMA copies linearly without alloc.
Ordered tagged list links new table via indirection when full. Alloc reuses dest matches, diverts over-limit, skips live ranges, may exchange; lookup recalls last dest tag.

Validation orders permission with allowance, mediation, lockdown, flag legality and segment bound. Signature is fatal under enforcement, may deny on appraisal with lockdown, else tolerated with diagnostic.

Preparation reads kernel under ceiling, probes, optional sig and ramfs, checks cmdline, appends buffers and invokes loader. Alloc sets markers, sanity and reserves pages with unwind. Default load forwards or reports absence; handover fallback is no-op success; post runs measurement then machine step.

Hashes retained segments plus zero fill, stores ranges, publishes regions and digest omitting purgatory, measurement and hotplug; staging pairs hash with ranges; may skip per-entry for non-crash with handover or all-movable; no-op without purgatory.

Headers need plausible sizes, current versions and overflow-free containment. Parsing checks length, magic, width, order, size and sanity with endian handling. Descriptors need wrap-free ranges. Collection abandons all on single failure; table decoded only when present. Description aggregates raw bytes, header and array.
Staging copies only loadable up to min of file and memory sizes. Magic is compared; numeric conversion follows encoding byte for little, big or native order.

Readouts give reboot and crash presence, reservation size, ranges and header size; size control shrinks on numeric write. Globals hold two images, progress, debug and disable. Diagnostics share module prefix.

Top-down and bottom-up searches align candidates, enforce bounds, step a page on dest overlap or arch exclusion. Callback skips driver, small or outside spans. Crash stays in reserve; others walk memblock or resources with clipped next-match. Contig refused for forbidding or crash, else busy on overlap. Order is preset base, handover, contig, walk.

Symbol search accepts only global name matches with in-range strings and valid sections. Sizing accumulates file and zero-fill with alignments. Layout assigns runtime addresses with single start fix. Relocation validates tables and delegates by flavor.
Headers archive is read-only attribute from linker symbols created at init and removed at cleanup. Perf symbol access needs build support and paranoid below threshold.

Bounded toggle uses generic parsing, updates bypass branch and warns only on change. Bypass is switchable or never. Poison writes pattern wordwise over span; low bound derives from poison search and tracked lowest with reset to task top.

locks.text: Each allowance counter has its own mutex. Negative sentinel means unlimited and never decrements; zero denies; updates serialize.
Atomic guard serializes reboot execution with busy when held and release on all exits. File install holds try lock whole duration, busy when held, releasing on unload and error paths.
Global resource read lock is held across next-match tree walk and released before return.

state_machines.text: Preserving branch freezes, suspends, quiesces then reverses. Normal flags progress, prepares, migrates, shuts services, re-enables hotplug, announces, shuts machine then hands off.
Allowance accepts only non-negative decreasing writes when enforced with guarded reads. Disable control allows only one-way enabled to disabled.
Probe checks compatibility with cleanup on reject. Install runs from auth to atomic publish protecting reserves.
Top-down placement aligns and retries on overlap or exclusion. Purgatory load sequences sizing, layout and relocation with release. Reverse walk collects then dispatches reverse releasing always.

structs.text: Allowance pairs mutex with count where negative means unlimited. Compat link entry pairs target name with legacy alias.

Placement buffer carries image, bounds, sizes, base, direction, handle and staging. Resource view carries bounds, flags, descriptor and parent with clipped copies. Purgatory state links header, writable headers and staging buffer.

No-dest sentinel is all-bits-set max unsigned long. Payload ceiling is min of 4GiB and max signed size. Internal header has include guard. Stable names cover disable, per-kind limits and kexec directory with loaded, crash, size, ranges, header size plus legacy aliases.
